Scanner account details.label: Tenant ID
Scanner account details.description: Obtain the Tenant ID from the Azure portal.

Scanner account details.label: Scanner account subscription ID
Scanner account details.description: Azure subscription ID for deploying Terraform as a scanner account.

Scanner account details.label: Scanner account preferred location
Scanner account details.description: The primary location for deploying all scanner-related resources.

Target account details.label: Target account management groups
Target account details.description: Optional. The list of management group ids to be enabled for event based scanning. Provide each value in quotes and separated by commas. For example, ["QF-3", "QF-2", "QF-1"]
Target account details.note: This field is not required for the AzureUSGovernment cloud because event-based scanning is currently not supported in that environment.

Target account details.label: Target account subscription IDs
Target account details.description:
The list of subscription IDs to be enabled for event based scanning. Provide each value in quotes and separated by commas. For example, ["d408f97e-xxxx-xxxx-xxx-50bbff759a5d",
    "4f1f9d77-xxx-xxxx-xxxx-1393d18aa43e"]
Target account details.note: This field is not required for the AzureUSGovernment cloud because event-based scanning is currently not supported in that environment.

Target account details.label: Target account locations
Target account details.description: The list of Azure locations the discovered VMs must belong to. Provide each value in quotes and separated by commas. For example, ['eastus', 'westus']

Target account details.label: Target role boundary
Target account details.description: Provide the subscription name to be scanned if the target is only a single subscription. Provide root Management Group ID if there are multiple subscriptions. For example, '/providers/Microsoft.Management/managementGroups/QUALYS'. This needs to be specified for both event or poll based scanning

Qualys parameters.label: API Gateway URL
Qualys parameters.description: The URL of the Qualys endpoint where scanner reports will be shared or uploaded. Please refer https://www.qualys.com/platform-identification/

Qualys parameters.label: Qualys endpoint token
Qualys parameters.description: The authentication token required for Qualys Endpoint.

VM Filter rules.label: Must have tags
VM Filter rules.description: All tags from the list must be present and considered during VM discovery. Add multiple values in a comma-separated format. For example, ['key=value', 'foo=bar', 'baz=true']

VM Filter rules.label: At least one tag
VM Filter rules.description: At least one tag from the list must be present and considered during VM discovery. Add multiple values in a comma-separated format. For example, ['key=value', 'foo=bar', 'baz=true']

VM Filter rules.label: None of the tag
VM Filter rules.description: No tag from the list must be present and considered during VM discovery. Add multiple values in a comma-separated format. For example, ['key=value', 'foo=bar', 'baz=true']

Scanner settings.label: Scan interval (in hours)
Scanner settings.description: The scan frequency where the scanner perform scans on an individual VM at the specified interval. Provide a value between 24 hours (1 day) and 720 hours (30 days).

Scanner settings.label: Poll interval (in hours)
Scanner settings.description: The polling frequency where the scanner fetches all VMs from the target subscriptions to scan them at specified intervals. Provide a value between 1 hour to 24 hours.

Scanner settings.label: Scanner pause interval (in minutes)
Scanner settings.description: The period where the scanner waits for the specified number of minutes before executing a scan on the discovered VMs. The scanner will be paused for a designated period to accommodate new VMs for scanning. Provide a value between 5 minutes to 720 minutes.

Scanner settings.label: Location Concurrency
Scanner settings.description: Provide the number of locations to be concurrently scanned. The value must be between 1 and 25

Scanner settings.label: Number of concurrent scanner machines per location
Scanner settings.description: The number of scanner machines to execute scans on a single location. You can provide a value from 1 to 30 VMs. Consider the VMs to consume for scanning when allocating vCPU quotas in Azure storage. For Quotas allocations, refer to the Azure Quotas documentation.

Scanner settings.label: Event Based Discovery
Scanner settings.description: When enabled, ephemeral VMs are automatically captured and scanned.

Scanner settings.label: Scan Sampling
Scanner settings.description: Select 'enabled' to use scan sampling, which involves selecting and analyzing a subset of VMs from a larger population to make inferences about the VMSS.

Scanner settings.label: Sampling Group Scan Percentage
Scanner settings.description: Provide the percentage to execute scans on sampling group VMSS. The value must be between 1 and 50.
